subject: [PATCH v6 RESEND 5/5] mm/memcontrol: add stock to the memsw page counter

2026-09-28.patch_summary: This patch adds a separate stock (bank) to the memsw page counter in Linux's memory control system, allowing it to operate independently of the main memory bank. The patch introduces new functions for scheduling and draining the stock, ensuring that failed allocations do not replenish the newly attached memsw stock. It also preserves user-visible cgroup-v1 invariant by reporting memory.memsw.usage_in_bytes as the larger raw value.
